Delete all local data?

This permanently removes your profile and preferences, movement answers, saved templates, every logged workout including one in progress, and cached weekly totals. It cannot be undone, and the app returns to first-run onboarding. Files you already exported are not deleted. Exercise artwork and the bundled catalog stay.
